name: Iceman
short: OpenCode's anonymous stealth reasoning model (262K/131K, Free) available on OpenCode Console and Go; measured on StealthMark 1.8.10 with active tool calling.
pricingNote: Free (prompts and completions retained for model training)
standout: Zero-cost reasoning and tool execution with 262K context for bulk coding prototypes and synthetic code tasks.
tradeoff: Text-only with no multimodal support; prompts and completions are retained for training, and planning/physics benchmarks test mid-low.
